commands.command:
set -eu
git fetch origin work/ux-evolution
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/ux-evolution)"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
uptime
set +e
LCL_E2E_PORT=5296 LCL_VISUAL_CONTRACT=1 pnpm exec playwright test -c apps/mobile/playwright.config.ts --grep='PLUGS_UI LED relay-state and off modes work end to end' --workers=1 --reporter=json >/tmp/shelly-ionic-led-172-e2e.json 2>/tmp/shelly-ionic-led-172-e2e.err
code=$?
set -e
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json
s=Path('/tmp/shelly-ionic-led-172-e2e.json').read_text(errors='replace')
try:
 j=json.loads(s[s.find('{'):]);print('SCOPED_E2E_STATS',j['stats'])
except Exception as err:print('JSON_ERROR',str(err),s[-1500:])
PY
echo "LED_E2E_EXIT=$code"
tail -25 /tmp/shelly-ionic-led-172-e2e.err || true
git status --short
test "$code" -eq 0
